payload.query:
query StudentStatistics($filter: StudentStatisticsFilter!) {
  studentStatistics(filter: $filter) {
    tasksCount
    tasksTotalTime
    tasksTotalTimeTrend
    withoutErrors
    withErrors
    withHints
    hasAnyStatistics
    days {
      correctAnswers
      date
      startTime
      finishTime
      points
      subjectsCount
      tasksCount
      usedTime
      withErrors
      withHints
      subjects {
        id
        isActive
        lockedClasses
        name
        weight
        color
        code
        isSchoolProgram
      }
    }
    subThemes {
      count
      dates
      id
      name
      points
    }
    themes {
      count
      dates
      id
      name
      points
      isSchoolProgram
    }
    subjects {
      count
      dates
      id
      name
      points
      isSchoolProgram
      successTasksCount
      failureTasksCount
      color
      usedTime
      pointsTrend
    }
  }
}
